name: sm712_pulse_clamp
spice:
* Datasheet clamping anchors; piecewise linear 8/20 us approximation
.OPTIONS TEMP=25 METHOD=GEAR ITL4=100 RELTOL=1u
Xp1s1a1 p1s1a1v p1s1a1b 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Ip1s1a1 0 p1s1a1v PWL(0 0 1u 0 9u 1 21u 0.5 81u 0 90u 0)
Ep1s1a1 p1s1a1abs 0 VALUE={1*V(p1s1a1v)}
Xp1s1a5 p1s1a5v p1s1a5b 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Ip1s1a5 0 p1s1a5v PWL(0 0 1u 0 9u 5 21u 2.5 81u 0 90u 0)
Ep1s1a5 p1s1a5abs 0 VALUE={1*V(p1s1a5v)}
Xp1s1a17 p1s1a17v p1s1a17b 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Ip1s1a17 0 p1s1a17v PWL(0 0 1u 0 9u 17 21u 8.5 81u 0 90u 0)
Ep1s1a17 p1s1a17abs 0 VALUE={1*V(p1s1a17v)}
Xp1sn1a1 p1sn1a1v p1sn1a1b 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Ip1sn1a1 0 p1sn1a1v PWL(0 0 1u 0 9u -1 21u -0.5 81u 0 90u 0)
Ep1sn1a1 p1sn1a1abs 0 VALUE={-1*V(p1sn1a1v)}
Xp1sn1a5 p1sn1a5v p1sn1a5b 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Ip1sn1a5 0 p1sn1a5v PWL(0 0 1u 0 9u -5 21u -2.5 81u 0 90u 0)
Ep1sn1a5 p1sn1a5abs 0 VALUE={-1*V(p1sn1a5v)}
Xp1sn1a17 p1sn1a17v p1sn1a17b 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Ip1sn1a17 0 p1sn1a17v PWL(0 0 1u 0 9u -17 21u -8.5 81u 0 90u 0)
Ep1sn1a17 p1sn1a17abs 0 VALUE={-1*V(p1sn1a17v)}
Xp2s1a1 p2s1a1a p2s1a1v 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Ip2s1a1 0 p2s1a1v PWL(0 0 1u 0 9u 1 21u 0.5 81u 0 90u 0)
Ep2s1a1 p2s1a1abs 0 VALUE={1*V(p2s1a1v)}
Xp2s1a5 p2s1a5a p2s1a5v 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Ip2s1a5 0 p2s1a5v PWL(0 0 1u 0 9u 5 21u 2.5 81u 0 90u 0)
Ep2s1a5 p2s1a5abs 0 VALUE={1*V(p2s1a5v)}
Xp2s1a17 p2s1a17a p2s1a17v 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Ip2s1a17 0 p2s1a17v PWL(0 0 1u 0 9u 17 21u 8.5 81u 0 90u 0)
Ep2s1a17 p2s1a17abs 0 VALUE={1*V(p2s1a17v)}
Xp2sn1a1 p2sn1a1a p2sn1a1v 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Ip2sn1a1 0 p2sn1a1v PWL(0 0 1u 0 9u -1 21u -0.5 81u 0 90u 0)
Ep2sn1a1 p2sn1a1abs 0 VALUE={-1*V(p2sn1a1v)}
Xp2sn1a5 p2sn1a5a p2sn1a5v 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Ip2sn1a5 0 p2sn1a5v PWL(0 0 1u 0 9u -5 21u -2.5 81u 0 90u 0)
Ep2sn1a5 p2sn1a5abs 0 VALUE={-1*V(p2sn1a5v)}
Xp2sn1a17 p2sn1a17a p2sn1a17v 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Ip2sn1a17 0 p2sn1a17v PWL(0 0 1u 0 9u -17 21u -8.5 81u 0 90u 0)
Ep2sn1a17 p2sn1a17abs 0 VALUE={-1*V(p2sn1a17v)}
.TRAN 20n 90u 0 20n
.PLOT TRAN v(p1s1a1abs)
.PLOT TRAN v(p1s1a5abs)
.PLOT TRAN v(p1s1a17abs)
.PLOT TRAN v(p1sn1a1abs)
.PLOT TRAN v(p1sn1a5abs)
.PLOT TRAN v(p1sn1a17abs)
.PLOT TRAN v(p2s1a1abs)
.PLOT TRAN v(p2s1a5abs)
.PLOT TRAN v(p2s1a17abs)
.PLOT TRAN v(p2sn1a1abs)
.PLOT TRAN v(p2sn1a5abs)
.PLOT TRAN v(p2sn1a17abs)
.END

provenance.notes: Datasheet VC maximum anchors. PWL rises to peak in 8 us, falls to half 20 us after start; an approximation, not a calibrated IEC generator. Voltage sampled at peak current. Each channel tested in its own instance. USB VBUS floating, no external bypass: device-only fixture; model at27 C vs table25 C. No thermal/damage/survival or simultaneous-channel claim.
provenance.numerical_tolerance: DC voltages 1 mV; leakage 1 nA; capacitance typical comparison +/-1%; these are test tolerances, not manufacturer tolerances
